profile.name: Daya Bharada
profile.title: Sr. Software Engineer | Tech Lead
profile.summary: 3+ years building scalable Angular & React.js applications with monorepo architecture and automated CI/CD pipelines. Expertise in REST API integration, RxJS state management, standalone components, signals & lazy loading for high-performance apps.

details: Participated in interviews for remote team hiring, aligning new candidates with project needs.
Contributed to ReactJS-based sub-projects involving Cypress testing.
Proactively handled production incidents and implemented RCA-driven solutions.
Integrated GitHub CI/CD pipelines and contributed to SOC compliance.
Deep-dive into ongoing enterprise-grade Angular projects with RxJS and Signals.
Architectural exposure to Micro-Frontend and Monorepo systems.
Collaborated with remote developers and conducted PR reviews.
Architected a unified staging environment, slashing costs by 25%.
Implemented Config-Driven Development (CDD), reducing code by 60%.
Mentored developers, resulting in a 20% team productivity increase.
Integrated dynamic email templates and complex reactive forms.
